Interface HomeObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIClientHandler, SocketClientHandler, VirtualClient
public interface HomeObserver
Observer notified when the list of open games in the server lobby changes. Implemented by VirtualClient to push HomeUpdate responses to clients that are on the home screen.
